mentions.name: IsModelAvailable
mentions.description: This website tracks LLM availability — which models are live, where, and on what terms — with a long-term plan to become a sort of JustWatch for LLMs. It was hacked together after the Fable 5 shutdown and is currently just a toy.
mentions.problem: Model shutdowns (such as the Fable 5 shutdown) leave no easy way to see which LLMs are live, where, and on what terms.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Mourning the Fable 5 shutdown, I hacked together https://ismodelavailable.com/fable
The long-term plan is a sort of JustWatch for LLMs - which models are live, where, on what terms. Right now it's just a toy.
